title_sq: Prane Pallatit Te Brigadave, Shitet Apartament 3+1+2 Perfekt Per Banim!!

title_en: Near the Palace of the Brigades, 3+1+2 Apartment for Sale, Perfect for Living!!
description_en: Near the Brigades Palace, 3+1+2 Apartment for sale, ideal investment for living. The apartment is located in a quality building where the ventilated facade, quality works and green space can be noticed. The apartment has an area of ​​153m2 gross and 126m2 net and is located on the 3rd floor of the building. The entrance is organized in a spacious and bright living room facing south, a kitchen separate from the living room, 3 bedrooms, one of which is a double, and two bathrooms, one of which has a window. It is worth noting the superior solid investment made in the apartment, quality parquet, internal doors, electrical and plumbing installations, plaster works, spotlights and LED works, toilets invested with the best companies in the market, as well as the multi-split air conditioning of the Mitsubishi Company. The area in which the apartment is located is an elite residential area thanks to the peace and clean air that nature provides.
